study.question: Can bounded target-dependent score-level intensity improve the existing softmax history pool after explicit action/field count and decay features? Observation: references have validation AUC .6050036 static, .6102261 pooled, .6133620 DIN; explicit match_count .6167541 versus support_count .6133185; aligned_time .6171490 versus duplicate_count .6166311. Later joint_pair .6183522 does not beat support_pair .6184567, action_attention .6179337 does not beat support_pair, separate routing does not beat aligned/shared, and adaptive queries .6185596 do not beat blind .6186035. Latest aligned_product .6179084 is below incumbent by .0006951 and below crossed_product .6183963; binding-by-operation interaction is -.0003587. Therefore do not extend the failed direct interaction readout or assume finer joint identity is useful. Incumbent source guarantees offset-invariant normalized routing and first-512 diagnostics show mean supplied length 118.115, nontrivial score variance (category 4.269, brand 5.952), but do not establish predictive value of absolute intensity. The gate question follows this concrete information limitation, not an industry ranking. Prior comparisons are single-seed observations, not independent repetitions or mechanism proof.
study.hypothesis: The normalized parent pool retains which events matter but removes whether the shared retrieval scorer considers the whole supplied history relevant to this ad. A bounded target-conditioned aggregate score can modulate that vector usefully even after count features. This is a provisional mechanism hypothesis; a generic rescaling, gradient-path change, score-shape statistic or regularization could explain a gain.

nearest_work.source_ref: paper:din; archived primary text content-sha256:5fee25f33f375e51b3ee9417d376ff9dbe2ea3628c932a7679ddfeb0feaaade2; text SHA256 83fb9eeca31e2fa3c557b6f08b893ad0018cefb33da6e00952136b9ce17e607e; arXiv:1706.06978v4 sec.4.3, lines 271-277 read via tools.py
nearest_work.difference: DIN already motivates relaxing attention normalization to retain interest intensity. Here routing stays exactly the local parent softmax distribution; only its pooled vector is multiplied by a bounded length-normalized average sigmoid score in [0,2]. This does not reproduce an unnormalized attention sum, reweight individual events, introduce a count signal, or establish novelty. Compare zero-query and score-centered replacements, not a capacity increase.

nearest_work.source_ref: r0005-query_blind; candidate.py source SHA256 9cc179ba81d736d49723b152aff730a6c43f35b31179cc964b60ff575ae04023; baseline_reference.py SHA256 ee10868f589c077b19f57a1fb07702c947c56e970994cdc537ef83ea2b8bc943
nearest_work.difference: Incumbent normalizes shared history weights to sum one for every nonempty history. This makes a uniform score offset invisible in routing. Proposed raw gate exposes score-level information while centered controls retain offset invariance. All source parameters and explicit features are inherited; no new trainable tensors.

inherited_components: Exact incumbent source, parameter shapes and constructor random-draw order; existing field/action/recency embeddings, shared local activation network, context augmentation and MLP.
All existing 24 explicit marginal-match, decay-match and pair-support features; loss, optimizer and training recipe unchanged.
DIN local activation and known interest-intensity motivation; this experiment is an adaptation and attribution test, not a new normalization principle.
study.proposed_difference: Add no parameters. Compute target-aware and zero-query history score streams from the same scorer and history values. Each produces raw and per-impression masked-mean-centered streams. In each of four standalone cells, g=2*sum(mask*sigmoid(stream))/max(1,valid_length), and only the parent pooled history vector is replaced by g*pool. No length mass is multiplied in. All four gates are computed in every mode; selection changes only the gradient-bearing gate. Empty histories have g=0 and exact zero pool. Padding is masked before gate mean/centering. Context attention, parent softmax routing and explicit features are unchanged at identical parameters. Missing target fields follow the parent zero-ID/context behavior; no new availability masking. The exact no-gate incumbent is available as a committed matched-recipe reference. A constant factor of two maps zero scores to unit gain on nonempty histories; its value is frozen rather than tuned.
predictions: Primary: target_raw exceeds both nearest controls target_centered and zero_raw and the incumbent in full-population validation ROC-AUC; D=(AUC_target_raw-AUC_target_centered)-(AUC_zero_raw-AUC_zero_centered)>0. No significance claim from a single seed.

Mechanistic activation: target_raw gates show nonzero across-impression variation, differ from zero_raw and target_centered, and respond to a common score shift while centered gates are invariant. Active paths do not by themselves prove utility.

Source invariants: selected pooled direction and within-history weight ratios match parent at fixed parameters; selected gain lies in [0,2]; padded gates/weights and empty-history pool remain zero; constructor parameter counts and initialization are unchanged.

Use existing host history-length, behavior-presence, hour, frequency and missing-field slices when available with samples/positives/negatives. No new confirmatory slice cutoffs are chosen after outcomes; small slices remain exploratory. Report unweighted Logloss and measured cost even if AUC wins.
falsifiers: target_raw fails to beat the incumbent, or absolute score level adds no gain over target_centered.
zero_raw matches or exceeds target_raw, or target-by-centering difference-in-differences is nonpositive; target-specific intensity explanation remains unsupported.
Gates collapse to nearly constant gains, saturate or have negligible pool/logit effects; this implementation does not test useful varying intensity adequately.
Padding or empty-history invariants fail, nonfinite logits occur, or construction differs between cells; treat as execution/integrity failure, not scientific counterevidence.
Positive single-seed effects reverse on paired seeds; record seed sensitivity and retain provisional conclusions.
alternative_explanations: One paired seed is preliminary; adaptive validation reuse can overfit selection. No user-cluster bootstrap interface or predictions is exposed.

Shared scorer is trained jointly with the multiplier; changes can alter learned embeddings and routing during retraining. This isolates an architectural intervention, not a fixed learned representation.
Absolute gates identify the final scorer bias whereas centered gates cancel it. Nominal capacity is identical but active gradient directions differ.
Target-independent gates can still interact with target-dependent parent routing. Target/zero refers only to the gate query.
All alternatives are computed in every cell but unused gradient branches differ; measured cost is required. A scalar learned rescaling can mimic some effects.

Existing explicit count/support features may already contain relevant intensity; normalized attention might be beneficial regularization. Fixed sigmoid gate/centering may be a poor realization, so failure is implementation-scoped.
The model is a shallow category/brand adaptation; external industrial multi-domain conversion results need not transfer. Static snapshot as-of dates are undocumented.
The first-512 candidate diagnostics are selected by host and descriptive, not representative label-conditioned effect estimates.

cost_plan.estimate_ref: Runtime frozen protocol unit 704.373s, last four receipts 722.657-739.083s, per-trial cap 1760.932s; reported remaining budget 62708.716s at context start. Four parameter-preserving variants add two history scorer evaluations plus reductions; conservatively plan <=1100s each (4400s total), hard-cap worst case 7043.730s. Syntax/source/scalar checks and all host diagnostics/trials count; no training is runnable locally. Local preparation and checks are charged by host ledger; the budget figure is a resolved starting snapshot, not a claim of unchanged remaining resources. Measured allocated GPU time is host-owned; this proposal reports past wall times only.
cost_plan.attribution_reserve: Reserve 8000s for discriminating follow-up including failed or saturated gate investigation and 4-cell replication if needed. Do not add capacity, loss or optimizer changes in this round. Pairwise contrasts and the 2x2 interaction are preregistered.
cost_plan.assessment_reserve: Reserve 16000s for validation-only final comparisons including 3 paired seeds (42/43/44) of selected candidate, closest controls and incumbent; prior seed42 receipts may be reused only with matching source/config/protocol hashes. No test access in this rerun. Freeze selected source/config/checkpoint suite and comparison commands before final validation repetition requests. No checkpoint artifact is available in this proposal phase.
cost_plan.stop_rule: No local training, installations, raw-data access or withheld assessment. Submit at most these four variants under the frozen contract; host stops at per-trial or total hard limit. Count failures and unknown execution states, never duplicate automatically. Keep reserves before any follow-up; if no admissible experiment plus assessment reserve fits, stop and report inconclusive/negative evidence rather than increasing limits.
